description: Closed list of destructive operations (REG-04, rule R4 of blueprint §4.4). Every listed document command implements IDestructiveCommand and every listed use case carries [Destructive]; both can only be dispatched with a ConfirmationToken issued by TwoStepConfirm (CLC0010). Architecture.Tests fails when a type implements IDestructiveCommand or carries [Destructive] without being listed, and when a listed type exists without the marker.

commands.name: DeleteShortcut
commands.description: Removes a shortcut from its list.

commands.name: DeleteProfile
commands.description: Removes a profile and its shortcuts.

commands.name: DeleteDuplicate
commands.description: Removes one appearance of a repeated shortcut.

commands.name: ResetFrequents
commands.description: Clears usage, pins and hidden entries (raises UsageEpoch).

commands.name: ReplaceOnImport
commands.description: Replaces the library with an imported one.

commands.name: RestoreBackup
commands.description: Replaces the document with a backup.

commands.name: DeleteMacroStep
commands.description: Removes a step from a macro.

commands.name: KeepOnlyInAlwaysVisible
commands.description: Keeps a repeated combination only in Always visible and removes its same-name appearances from the profiles (REP-005).

useCases.name: RollbackVersion
useCases.description: Goes back to the previous installed version (N-1).

useCases.name: UninstallKeepOrDeleteData
useCases.description: Uninstalls from the Control Center (System > Uninstall); the data is kept unless the person asks to delete it, after saving a copy (NFR-010, ADR-0029). ISystemUninstall.UninstallAsync only runs with the ConfirmationToken of this operation.

useCases.name: StartFromScratchOnReinstall
useCases.description: Replaces the document with the one of a new installation when a reinstallation found data from before (NFR-010, proposal P6, ADR-0029). It is dispatched as the RestoreBackup command, with a backup of the current document first and undo.
